verdict.rationale: Deel provides API reference docs listing endpoints (POST /rest/contracts) plus a dedicated Sandbox environment with pre-populated data for safely testing API calls, which supports exploratory/runnable use, and an MCP tools reference listing callable tools with structured I/O. However, there is no explicit evidence of an interactive in-docs console (e.g., 'Try it' buttons, live runnable code snippets) typical of API reference tools like Swagger/Postman embeds. Missing for 10: evidence of an embedded interactive try-it console or live runnable examples in the docs UI, and independent/hands-on confirmation of this specific experience.
